notes: *a third part* heads on *third* under rule 31's subtraction test, *part* being the generic the ASV supplies to complete the ordinal; the article on the ordinal is unrepresented because the ASV writes no determiner for it (rule 29), the indefinite *a* being the nominal expression's own under rule 15.

The predicate לְ of *shall be porters* is read as rule 49's resultative preposition carrying the whole supplied frame, headed on *be*; the competing reading would mark it unrepresented and give *shall be* to שֹׁעֲרֵי, which rule 49 excludes.

The *on* before *the sabbath* answers to the relation between בָּאֵי and its rectum and stays with שַׁבָּת (rule 19); it is not a preposition the English verb's valency needs to reach an object, so rule 44 does not reach it.
